items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Price targets cut across RBC, BofA, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Mizuho, UBS and Argus, reflecting lower multiples linked to softer lithium sentiment and recent spot price weakness. Truist, Scotiabank and Argus cite cost efficiencies and resilient lithium demand.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered Albemarle PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform; lowering lithium company targets following recent spot price weakness, though still views the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand up 45% through May, driven by stationary storage; inventories near record lows; spodumene inventories near historic lows. Company maintained 2026 outlook, expects high end of scenario ranges; $100M run-rate savings YTD.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; ratification vote pending.
